author: Linnaeus, 1758
status: 여름철새 수천 마리 · 텃새 수백 마리
habitat: 호소, 소택지, 연못, 저수지, 하구 등 물이 고인 곳
summary: 흔한 여름철새로, 호소와 소택지, 호숫가, 연못가, 저수지, 하구 등 물이 고인 곳에 산다. 국내에서는 중부 이남 전역에서 지낸다. 한배에 알을 6~9개 낳으며, 여러 열매와 곤충, 연체동물, 갑각류, 환형동물을 먹는다. 국외에서는 호주와 뉴질랜드를 뺀 전 세계의 온대와 열대에 분포한다.

points.en: undertail coverts black in the centre, white at the sides

art.subject: Common Moorhen (Gallinula chloropus), adult, as seen on Korean ponds and reed-fringed reservoirs from April to October: head, neck and underparts dark slate-grey to sooty black; back, wings and rump dark olive-brown; a broken white line of streaks along the flanks below the folded wing; belly feathers with faint pale fringes; undertail coverts black in the centre and white at the sides, flashed as the tail is flicked. Frontal shield bright red, flat and rounded at the top; bill bright red with a yellow tip. Iris red. Legs and long toes yellow-green, with a red ring ('garter') at the top of the bare tibia.
art.pose: standing at the water's edge among reeds, side view
art.scene: Korean summer pond or reservoir edge with reeds and still water; no people, buildings or text
views: adult, side view standing at the water's edge: slate-black head and underparts, dark olive-brown back and wings, white flank line, red frontal shield, red bill with a yellow tip, yellow-green legs with a red garter
adult, rear view swimming with the tail cocked: undertail coverts black in the centre with white sides, short dark tail, dark olive-brown back
art.build: Medium-sized rail, about 32cm, roughly the length of a Feral Pigeon but plumper, with a small head, a short tail and fairly long legs. Bill short and conical, shorter than the head, running straight up into the frontal shield on the forehead. Toes very long and slender, without lobes or webs. Swims buoyantly with the head bobbing and the short tail held up and flicked, showing the white undertail sides; walks deliberately over floating vegetation. Flies weakly with the legs dangling.
avoid: Do not paint a white frontal shield and white bill — that is Eurasian Coot (Fulica atra).
Do not paint the bill all red; the tip is yellow.
Do not paint lobed or webbed toes.
Do not omit the white line along the flank.
